en.headline: Privacy office opens compliance check on 24/7 Fitness
en.dek: The Privacy Commissioner said it has asked 24/7 Fitness for details of the steps taken after a camera was found in a changing room.
body: The Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data said on Monday it has opened a compliance check on the 24-hour gym chain 24/7 Fitness, after a camera was found in a changing room and members raised concerns about their privacy.

The office said it has asked the company for further information on the security measures taken after the incident, and on whether those measures are enough to stop a similar case. It said the review is meant to ensure members' personal data are properly protected.

Anyone who believes their personal-data privacy has been infringed can contact the organisation concerned or enquire with the commissioner's office, the office said. Police had earlier arrested a man in connection with a camera found at a Sha Tin branch; he has not been named in the commissioner's statement.

zh.headline: 私隱公署主動對24/7 Fitness展開循規審查
zh.dek: 個人資料私隱專員公署表示，已要求健身中心交代更衣室發現攝錄鏡頭後採取的保障措施，以及措施是否足以防止類似事件。
body: 個人資料私隱專員公署星期一表示，留意到連鎖24小時健身中心24/7 Fitness早前被發現更衣室內藏有針孔攝錄鏡頭，引起會員關注私隱，公署已主動展開循規審查。
公署說，已要求有關機構提供進一步資料，了解事件發生後就保障會員個人資料所採取的安全措施，以及有關措施是否足以防止同類事件再次發生。公署強調，審查是為確保會員的個人資料私隱得到充分保障。
公署又說，任何人如懷疑個人資料私隱被侵犯，可聯絡有關機構，亦可向私隱專員公署查詢。警方較早前就沙田一間分店發現攝錄鏡頭拘捕一名男子；公署聲明沒有點名涉事人士。
